beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Last time, you watched two speeches decide the fate of the world. This time, something harder to believe. You were in the room.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Scripture is not shy about this. When God needed to steady a frightened young prophet, He reminded Jeremiah where he came from:

beats.speaker: father
beats.text: Before I formed thee in the belly I knew thee; and before thou camest forth out of the womb I sanctified thee, and I ordained thee a prophet unto the nations.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Known before the womb. Not manufactured at birth — known. And when Job hit the floor of his suffering, God lifted his chin with a memory:

beats.speaker: father
beats.text: Where wast thou when I laid the foundations of the earth? When the morning stars sang together, and all the sons of God shouted for joy?

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: All the sons of God, shouting for joy, while the earth was being built. That shout was ours. We watched the foundations poured — and we cheered, because that world was being built for us.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Abraham was shown even further back. He saw the spirits that existed before the world — organized, real, eternal. His own account:

beats.speaker: scripture
beats.text: Now the Lord had shown unto me, Abraham, the intelligences that were organized before the world was; and among all these there were many of the noble and great ones.

beats.speaker: father
beats.text: Abraham, thou art one of them; thou wast chosen before thou wast born.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Chosen before you were born. And that is not poetry reserved for Abraham — it is the family truth. Paul stood in the middle of Athens and said it to strangers:

beats.speaker: scripture
beats.text: For in him we live, and move, and have our being; as certain also of your own poets have said, For we are also his offspring.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Offspring. Not inventions. Not accidents of chemistry. Children — of glorified Parents — with eternity behind us, and their kind of life ahead of us, if we want it.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Which means the stranger you pass in traffic is older than the earth. The child asleep in your arms watched the foundations of the world. And the face in your mirror belongs to someone who stood in that council — and shouted for joy.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The devil needs you to forget every word of this. You're worthless. You're an animal. You're alone. You're an accident. Every one of those lies is aimed at a single target: your memory of who you are.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: And God's first move, in every age, is the opposite. He tells His children who they are. Because a person who knows they are a child of God — chosen before birth — is very, very hard to enslave.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: You are not a body that happens to have a soul. You are an eternal being who wanted this life so much you shouted when it was announced. Live like someone who chose to be here. Because you did.

card.speaker: narrator
card.text: You are older than the earth. You are a child of God. And you chose to be here.
